actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE original complete game animation sprite, 1024x1024 or larger square, truly transparent alpha background, no shadow, no checkerboard. Reference image 1 is the exact identity of 09 bamboo archer girl; reference image 2 is the primary approved rendering style only. Preserve her round green-eyed face, brown high ponytail with bamboo-leaf gold and jade ornament, green-white-gold short Daoist jacket, white shorts, yin-yang waist buckle with jade tassels, white-green-gold boots, bamboo longbow and back quiver. Same bright clean rounded high-definition hand-painted finish. Fixed orthographic camera looking downward only 10 degrees, 2.4-head-tall chibi proportions; entire figure and bow inside image, occupying about 84% image height with generous margin. NORTHWEST facing toward SCREEN UPPER LEFT, strict REAR three-quarter view, showing the back of the head and left ear and only a tiny cheek sliver, not a front view. Head torso hips and both boots point northwest. Clearly visible back quiver and back of outfit. This is WALK cycle frame NW01 of 16: left leg stretches FORWARD toward screen upper-left for heel-contact landing, right leg trails toward lower-right with heel raised and toe pushing on floor. Clearly two separate legs, normal compact walking stride, no jumping; at least one foot planted. Body centered, ground contact near y=930. Left hand holds the bow's middle grip while travelling, left elbow slightly bent lifting the bow clear of ground; full elegant bamboo longbow about 80% character height, not mini bow, not aimed; no nocked arrow, no pulling string. Right arm naturally counter-swings forward. Ponytail and coat tails gently trail toward screen lower-right. Pose must be newly drawn, not copied/mirrored/warped from reference. Keep silhouette readable, anatomy clean, crisp alpha edges with no magenta/yellow/red edge contamination. No text, grid, frame, UI, extra pose, weapon effects or scenery.
